items.title_en: Universal-KY Benefits from Gradual Relief of Substrate Shortage, Operations Expected to Grow Quarterly
paras: 三五族光通訊廠環宇-KY(4991-TW)受惠於受惠AI光通訊產品需求逐步增溫，加上磷化銦(InP)基板上游料件缺料問題解決，8月營收2.62億元、月增80.31％、年增45.62％，雙雙成長。法人預期，隨著基板缺料情況逐步緩解，環宇-KY目前基板供應量可提供支應至今(2026)年年底，今、明(2027)年業績可望持續增溫。
據了解，多家三五族群光通訊廠，磷化銦(InP)基板在今年5月底已先進來首批原料、7月持續進口下，已舒緩缺料出貨困境。環宇-KY，目前供應量則預期可支應至今年年底，將帶動PD(光電二極體)產品進一步放量。
環宇-KY目前 200G PD已進入量產階段，有望成為明年重要成長動能，雷射產品方面，70mW CW Laser已通過多家客戶驗證，100mW產品則持續進行客戶端可靠度測試，預估雷射產品於明年起可逐步發酵。
外資報告則指出，環宇-KY受惠AI光通訊規格升級，PD單位售價可期成長至原先的6-8倍，帶動環宇毛利率增加，未來出貨有望逐步放量，預估今年到2028年EPS有望持續成長，給予買進評等。
paras_en: Universal-KY (4991-TW), a member of the 35-group optical communications manufacturers, is benefiting from the warming demand for AI optical communication products and the resolution of upstream indium phosphide (InP) substrate material shortages. In August, revenue reached NT$262 million, up 80.31% month‑over‑month and 45.62% year‑over‑year, both showing double‑digit growth. Analysts expect that as substrate shortages ease, Universal‑KY’s current substrate supply can meet demand through the end of 2026, and performance is likely to keep heating up through 2027.

According to sources, several 35‑group optical communication firms received the first batch of InP substrates at the end of May 2024, and continued imports in July have alleviated the shipment bottleneck. Universal‑KY’s supply is projected to last until the end of this year, which should further boost volume of its PD (photodiode) products.

Universal‑KY’s 200‑Gbit/s photodiodes have entered mass production and are expected to become a key growth driver next year. On the laser side, the 70‑mW CW laser has passed verification by multiple customers, while the 100‑mW model is undergoing reliability testing with customers. Laser products are anticipated to gradually take off starting next year.

Foreign analyst reports note that Universal‑KY benefits from AI optical‑communication specification upgrades, with unit PD prices expected to rise to 6‑8 times prior levels, lifting the company’s gross margin. Future shipments are projected to increase steadily, and EPS is forecast to keep growing through 2028, leading to a buy rating.

items.title: 喊高目標卻更像看空！美銀估標普500年底跌3.4%
items.title_en: Bank of America Raises S&P 500 Target Yet Looks Bearish, Forecasts 3.4% Year‑End Drop
paras: 美國銀行(BAC-US)美股與量化策略主管Savita Subramanian調高標普500指數目標，將今年底預測由7,100點上修至7,400點。不過，新目標仍較上周五收盤低3.4%，在《彭博》調查的逾20名華爾街策略師中，依舊屬於最悲觀的預測之一。
Subramanian同時預估，標普500指數未來12個月將升至7,800點，但與目前水準相比僅有約2%上漲空間。她周一(14日)在客戶報告中表示，美股即將進入季節性表現較弱的時期，市場也已累積相當大的回檔壓力。
她指出，美股2026年至今僅在3月出現一次超過5%的修正，低於每年平均約3次的歷史頻率；美銀追蹤的熊市預警指標已有50%亮起警訊，顯示投資人不宜忽視短期下跌風險。
美股周一走低，主要AI企業高層呼籲放慢模型開發速度，與川普政府及華爾街力推AI投資的立場形成衝突。與此同時，國際油價上漲加深市場對通膨與借貸成本升高的憂慮，10年期美債殖利率一度突破5%，為2023年以來首見。
Subramanian仍對通膨風險及聯準會(Fed)升息保持警戒。她表示，目前金融條件已相當緊繃，任何進一步推高融資成本的因素，都可能加速市場承受痛苦。她並警告，信用周期通常緩慢惡化，但最後往往以快速且痛苦的方式告終。
不過，她仍將生產力提升視為標普500指數的長期多頭支柱。Subramanian預估，標普500企業每股盈餘(EPS)2026年將成長33%，2027年再成長12%，表現可望優於總體經濟預測，主要受到AI資本支出、製造業活動及生產力提升支撐。
她也不太擔心民主黨在今年期中選舉全面勝出後，可能限制AI支出，原因是目前AI基礎設施建設主要由共和黨執政州的地方政府推動。
其他華爾街機構則明顯樂觀。摩根大通(JPM-US)策略師Dubravko Lakos-Bujas帶領的團隊8月將標普500指數目標上調至8,000點，華爾街資深策略師Ed Yardeni隨後更喊出8,400點，凸顯市場對美股後市仍存在顯著分歧。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) U.S. equities and quantitative strategy head Savita Subramanian raised the S&P 500 target, lifting the year‑end forecast from 7,100 points to 7,400 points. However, the new target is still 3.4% below last Friday’s close and remains one of the most pessimistic among more than 20 Wall Street strategists surveyed by Bloomberg.

Subramanian also projects the S&P 500 will climb to 7,800 points over the next 12 months, which represents only about a 2% upside from current levels. In a client note on Monday the 14th she said U.S. equities are about to enter a seasonally weaker performance period and that the market has already built up substantial pull‑back pressure.

She noted that U.S. equities have seen only one correction of more than 5% since March 2026, well below the historical average of roughly three such moves per year, and that the bear‑market warning indicator tracked by Bank of America is now flashing at 50%, suggesting investors should not ignore short‑term downside risk.

U.S. stocks fell on Monday as senior executives at major AI firms called for a slowdown in model development, clashing with the Trump administration and Wall Street’s push for AI investment. At the same time, rising international oil prices deepened concerns about inflation and higher borrowing costs, and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield briefly broke above 5% – the first time since 2023.

Subramanian remains vigilant about inflation risk and Federal Reserve rate hikes. She said financial conditions are already quite tight and any factor that pushes financing costs higher could accelerate market pain. She warned that credit cycles usually deteriorate slowly but tend to end quickly and painfully.

Nevertheless, she still views productivity gains as the long‑term bullish foundation for the S&P 500. Subramanian estimates that S&P 500 companies’ earnings per share will grow 33% in 2026 and a further 12% in 2027, outpacing overall economic forecasts, driven mainly by AI capital spending, manufacturing activity and productivity improvements.

She is also not overly concerned that a Democratic sweep in this year’s midterm elections could curb AI spending, noting that most AI infrastructure projects are currently being driven by local governments in Republican‑led states.

Other Wall Street firms are markedly more optimistic. JPMorgan (JPM-US) strategist Dubravko Lakos‑Bujas’s team raised its S&P 500 target to 8,000 points in August, and veteran strategist Ed Yardeni later called for 8,400 points, highlighting the significant divergence in views on the market’s outlook.

items.title: 加拿大央行又要出手？8月通膨卡在3% 市場押注下月升息機率75%
items.title_en: Bank of Canada May Act Again? August Inflation Stuck at 3% Market Bets 75% Chance of Rate Hike Next Month
paras: 加拿大8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率維持在3%，符合市場預期，汽油漲幅放緩抵銷旅遊團費與租金上揚的影響。數據顯示核心物價壓力大致受控，但中東衝突推升能源成本，市場仍預估加拿大央行下月可能升息。
加拿大統計局周一(14日)公布，8月CPI較前月下跌0.1%，同樣符合經濟學家預估。加拿大央行偏好的加權中位數與截尾平均核心通膨率，分別維持在2%與1.9%，接近央行設定的2%目標。
汽油價格較去年同期上漲22.8%，漲幅低於7月的25.7%。不過，旅遊團費年增率由15.2%擴大至26.1%，部分反映去年同期赴美旅遊減少造成的低基期效應；租金漲幅也由2.5%升至2.8%。食品雜貨價格則上漲2.8%，低於7月的3.1%，近兩年來首度低於整體通膨率。

油價轉嫁風險升高 市場估下月升息機率75%

雖然核心通膨仍相對溫和，但已有跡象顯示能源成本正逐漸向其他商品與服務轉嫁。8月漲幅達3%以上的CPI項目占比由34.8%升至37.3%；央行核心通膨指標的3個月移動平均年率也由2.01%加速至2.19%，扣除食品與能源的年增率則由1.9%升至2.1%。
加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)本月稍早警告，中東衝突持續愈久，能源價格向整體經濟擴散的可能性就愈高。雖然美加貿易緊張也會增加通膨風險，但高能源價格才是更大的威脅。
隔夜交換市場顯示，加拿大央行下月升息的機率約為75%，CPI公布後大致不變。不過，多名經濟學家認為，第三季經濟成長已有放緩跡象，加上核心通膨仍在2%附近，市場的升息押注可能操之過急。
多倫多道明銀行(TD-US)經濟學家Leslie Preston預估，核心通膨未來幾個月可能回升，但起點很低，應仍處於加拿大央行可接受範圍。美國關稅與貿易政策的不確定性將持續壓抑加拿大出口及經濟成長。

加元跌至12日低點 Fed升息預期推高美元

CPI公布後，加拿大2年期公債殖利率上升約3個基點至3.384%，盤中一度觸及3.437%，創2024年8月以來最高。加元兌美元則貶值0.3%至1美元兌1.3915加元，盤中最低跌至1.3929，寫下9月2日以來最弱水準。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，加元走弱主要是美元全面上漲所致。中東衝突推升油價並帶動避險需求，加上市場押注聯準會(Fed)周三將進行逾兩年來首次升息，進一步支撐美元。
美加貿易爭端也對加元構成壓力。投資人質疑川普日前暗示的貿易協議能否迅速達成。加拿大總理卡尼(Mark Carney)本周則在多倫多接待數十名全球投資人，希望為逾160項關鍵計畫引進資金，協助加拿大經濟因應與美國的貿易戰。
paras_en: Canada's August consumer price index (CPI) year‑over‑year rate held at 3%, matching market expectations, as slower gasoline price gains offset higher tour package costs and rising rents. The data show core price pressures are broadly under control, but Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy costs keep the market forecasting a possible rate hike by the Bank of Canada next month.

Statistics Canada released on Monday (the 14th) that August CPI fell 0.1% from the previous month, also in line with economists' forecasts. The Bank of Canada's preferred weighted median and trimmed‑mean core inflation rates remained at 2% and 1.9% respectively, close to its 2% target.

Gasoline prices were up 22.8% year‑over‑year, a slower rise than July’s 25.7%. However, tour‑package price inflation jumped from 15.2% to 26.1%, partly reflecting a low‑base effect from fewer trips to the United States a year earlier; rent inflation also rose from 2.5% to 2.8%. Grocery prices increased 2.8%, below July’s 3.1% and, for the first time in two years, below the overall inflation rate.

Pass‑through risk from oil prices is rising, and the market estimates a 75% chance of a rate hike next month. Although core inflation remains relatively mild, there are signs that energy costs are gradually being passed on to other goods and services. The share of CPI components that rose more than 3% in August climbed from 34.8% to 37.3%; the three‑month moving‑average annualised rate of the Bank’s core inflation gauge accelerated from 2.01% to 2.19%, while the core‑‑excluding‑food‑and‑energy rate rose from 1.9% to 2.1%.

Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem warned earlier this month that the longer the Middle‑East conflict persists, the greater the likelihood that higher energy prices will spread throughout the economy. While US‑Canada trade tensions could also add inflationary pressure, soaring energy prices pose the bigger threat.

Overnight swap markets show the probability of a Bank of Canada rate hike next month at about 75%, essentially unchanged after the CPI release. However, several economists note that Q3 growth is already showing signs of slowing and core inflation is still hovering near 2%, suggesting the market’s rate‑hike bets may be premature.

TD‑US economist Leslie Preston projects that core inflation could rebound in the coming months, but from a very low base and likely remain within the Bank of Canada’s acceptable range. Uncertainty around US tariff and trade policy will continue to weigh on Canadian exports and economic growth.

After the CPI report, the yield on Canada’s two‑year government bond rose roughly 3 basis points to 3.384%, briefly touching 3.437% intraday – the highest since August 2024. The Canadian dollar slipped 0.3% to US$1.3915, hitting a intraday low of 1.3929, its weakest level since September 2.

Bannockburn Global Forex chief market strategist Marc Chandler said the loonie’s weakness is mainly due to a broadly stronger dollar. The Middle‑East conflict has pushed oil prices higher and boosted safe‑haven demand, while markets are betting that the Fed will raise rates on Wednesday – the first hike in over two years – further supporting the dollar.

US‑Canada trade disputes also pressure the Canadian dollar. Investors are questioning whether the trade agreement hinted at by former President Trump can be reached quickly. Prime Minister Mark Carney this week hosted dozens of global investors in Toronto, seeking funding for more than 160 key projects to help Canada’s economy cope with the trade war with the United States.

items.title: 不升恐傷Fed公信力、升息又恐惹怒川普 華許如何突圍？
items.title_en: No Rate Hike Could Hurt Fed Credibility, Raising Rates Might Anger Trump: How Will Warsh Navigate?
paras: 美國通膨再度升溫、油價突破每桶100美元，加上金融市場已高度押注升息，聯準會(Fed)本周似乎已為新任主席華許(Kevin Warsh)任內首次升息備妥條件。市場普遍預期，Fed將升息1碼，把聯邦資金利率目標區間提高至3.75%至4.00%，並可能暗示今年仍有進一步緊縮空間。
Fed將在為期兩天的會議結束後，於美東時間周三下午2時、台灣時間周四凌晨2時公布利率決策。期貨市場目前反映的升息機率約85%，但華許向來不願提供利率路徑指引，若Fed升息，他勢必面臨市場追問下一步行動。

通膨與油價夾擊 華許恐難再按兵不動

一周前，市場對本次會議結果遠沒有如此篤定。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)9月初還主張「給通膨降溫一個機會」，認為6、7月數據顯示通膨正朝2%目標靠攏；紐約Fed總裁威廉斯(John Williams)也表示，應該繼續觀察。
然而，美國8月排除食品與能源的核心消費者物價指數(CPI)月增0.3%，升幅遠高於符合Fed通膨目標的水準。中東戰事再起又將油價推升至每桶100美元以上，進一步加劇物價壓力，也削弱通膨正以「明確且足夠快的速度」回落至2%的信心。
克里夫蘭Fed總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)、達拉斯Fed總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)及明尼阿波利斯Fed總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)早在7月便主張升息，並對按兵不動的決定投下反對票。其他多名官員也曾表示，若未能很快看到通膨降溫，將轉而支持升息。
摩根大通(JPM-US)經濟學家Michael Feroli指出，華許一再嚴厲警告絕不容忍通膨，若沒有實際行動配合，恐損害Fed的制度公信力。他預期Fed周三將升息，但認為實際決策比市場反映的85%機率更為接近勢均力敵。

升息恐踩川普紅線 利率指引成更大考驗

華許若升息，也可能與美國總統川普產生衝突。川普任命華許時明確期待他降低利率，儘管目前仍將無法降息歸咎於其他具有「政治動機」的Fed官員，但距離11月國會期中選舉僅剩數周，白宮將如何回應升息仍是未知數。
道明證券(TD Securities)經濟學家Oscar Munoz表示，若Fed緊縮政策，華許必然會被追問未來是否繼續升息；如果9月踏上升息道路，後續可能還有更多緊縮，他將很難完全拒絕提供方向。
豐業銀行(Scotiabank)經濟學家Derek Holt雖認為現在升息是錯誤決定，卻仍預期Fed將採取行動。他指出，華許過度強調尊重市場訊號，等於把自己逼進牆角：「如果市場已經反映升息而Fed仍不行動，那還要等到什麼時候？」
EY-Parthenon經濟學家Gregory Daco預估，華勒與威廉斯最終也可能以通膨下降速度不夠快為由支持升息。若僅有一至兩名官員主張按兵不動，華許便可藉由多數共識，在不必高調主導的情況下投票支持升息。
paras_en: U.S. inflation is heating up again, oil prices have broken $100 a barrel, and financial markets are already heavily betting on rate hikes, so the Fed this week appears to be setting the stage for its new chair Kevin Warsh's first rate increase. The market broadly expects the Fed to raise rates by one quarter point, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4.00%, and may signal further tightening room later this year.

The Fed will announce its rate decision at 2 p.m. Eastern time on Wednesday (2 a.m. Taiwan time on Thursday) after a two‑day meeting. Futures currently price an about 85% chance of a hike, but Warsh has traditionally shied away from providing a rate‑path outlook, and if the Fed does raise rates he will inevitably face market pressure for guidance on the next move.

Inflation and oil price spikes could make it hard for Warsh to stay on the sidelines. A week ago the market was far less certain about the meeting outcome. Fed Governor Christopher Waller in early September still advocated “giving inflation a chance to cool,” saying June‑July data showed inflation moving toward the 2% goal, and New York Fed President John Williams also said the situation should be watched further.

However, core CPI – which strips out food and energy – rose 0.3% month‑over‑month in August, well above the level consistent with the Fed’s target. Renewed fighting in the Middle East has pushed oil above $100 a barrel, adding price pressure and weakening confidence that inflation is falling back to 2% at a “clear and sufficiently fast” pace.

Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari all called for a hike as early as July and voted against a hold. Several other officials have also said that without a rapid cooling of inflation they would shift to supporting a rate increase.

JPMorgan economist Michael Feroli warned that Warsh’s repeated stern warnings against tolerating inflation could damage the Fed’s institutional credibility if not backed by action. He expects a hike on Wednesday, but thinks the actual decision is even more evenly split than the market’s 85% probability suggests.

A rate hike could also run afoul of President Trump’s red line. Trump appointed Warsh with a clear expectation that he would lower rates, and while any inability to cut now would likely be blamed on other Fed officials with “political motives,” the November midterm election is only weeks away, leaving the White House’s response to a hike uncertain.

TD Securities economist Oscar Munoz said that if the Fed tightens, Warsh will inevitably be asked whether further hikes are coming; if September starts a hike path, more tightening could follow, making it hard for him to completely refuse to provide direction.

Scotiabank economist Derek Holt, while believing a hike now would be the wrong call, still expects the Fed to act. He noted that Warsh’s over‑emphasis on respecting market signals corners him: “If the market has already priced in a hike and the Fed still does nothing, when will it finally act?”

EY‑Parthenon economist Gregory Daco projects that Waller and Williams could ultimately back a hike on the grounds that inflation isn’t falling fast enough. If only one or two officials favor a hold, Warsh could ride a majority consensus to vote for a hike without having to lead the charge.

items.title: 美股警報響了？10年期美債殖利率攻上5% 創近3年新高
items.title_en: U.S. Stock Alert? 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits 5%, Near 3-Year High
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率周一(14日)升破5%，創2023年10月以來最高，投資人正為聯準會(Fed)本周利率決策做準備。這項影響房貸、車貸與信用卡利率的基準殖利率上升逾2個基點至5%；若進一步突破5.02%，將創2007年7月、全球金融危機爆發前以來最高水準。
對Fed政策最敏感的2年期美債殖利率也上漲逾2個基點至4.666%，上周一度觸及2024年7月以來最高；30年期美債殖利率則升至5.374%。債券價格與殖利率走勢相反，1個基點等於0.01個百分點。
美國上周五公布的8月消費者物價指數(CPI)符合預期，但通膨率仍遠高於Fed的2%目標。這也是Fed周二至周三召開決策會議前取得的最後一項通膨數據。芝商所(CME-US)FedWatch工具顯示，市場目前預估Fed升息1碼的機率達90%。
Freedom Capital Markets首席市場策略師Jay Woods表示，依據經濟數據與市場預期，升息是較為乾脆的決定，市場也可能在升息後反彈；反之，若Fed按兵不動，恐被解讀為再次落後情勢，引發負面反應。
美債殖利率上升的原因將決定其對股市的影響。若殖利率走高源於經濟成長強勁，未必對股市不利；但若反映通膨復燃、政府赤字擴大或美債市場承壓，風險便明顯升高。
Albion Financial Group投資長Jason Ware指出，美國財政部與企業大量發債、競逐投資人資金，造成供需失衡，是殖利率走高的原因之一。不過，10年期殖利率跨越5%這項心理關卡，未必會立即擊垮市場；相較之下，消費支出或AI投資放緩可能對股市構成更大威脅。
然而，龐大財政赤字、沉重發債量、通膨黏著及油價飆升，正推高投資人持有長期債券所要求的期限溢價。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)雖擴大債券回購計畫，試圖壓抑長端殖利率，但面對每日交易規模達1.2兆美元的美債市場，效果仍相當有限。
蒙特婁銀行(BMO-US)策略師認為，擴大回購只能減輕賣壓，無法解決10年期與30年期殖利率上升的基本面因素。若融資成本、保證金要求或市場波動升高，還可能迫使採取高槓桿基差交易的避險基金同步平倉，進一步放大美債跌勢。
目前投資人仍願意容忍較高殖利率。蒙特婁銀行指出，10年期殖利率先前升至4.85%時，美股僅小幅走弱，標普500指數今年迄今仍上漲逾11%。
paras_en: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields rose above 5% on Monday (the 14th), the highest since October 2023, as investors prepare for the Fed’s interest‑rate decision this week. The benchmark yield that influences mortgage, auto loan and credit‑card rates climbed more than 2 basis points to 5%; a further breach of 5.02% would mark the highest level since July 2007, before the global financial crisis.

The Fed‑sensitive 2-year Treasury yield also rose more than 2 basis points to 4.666%, briefly hitting its highest since July 2024 last week, while the 30-year yield rose to 5.374%. Bond prices move inversely to yields, with one basis point equal to 0.01 percentage point.

U.S. CPI data for August released last Friday met expectations, but inflation remains far above the Fed’s 2% target. It is the last inflation reading before the Fed’s decision meetings on Tuesday and Wednesday. CME‑US FedWatch shows the market currently assigns a 90% probability to a 25‑basis‑point rate hike.

Freedom Capital Markets chief market strategist Jay Woods said that, based on the data and market expectations, a rate hike is the more decisive move and the market could rebound after a hike; conversely, if the Fed holds steady, it may be read as falling further behind the situation, triggering a negative reaction.

The reason for the rise in Treasury yields will determine its impact on equities. If yields climb because of strong economic growth, it may not hurt stocks; but if the rise reflects rekindled inflation, expanding fiscal deficits or pressure on the Treasury market, the risk to equities becomes markedly higher.

Albion Financial Group chief investment officer Jason Ware noted that massive Treasury and corporate issuance competing for investor capital has created a supply‑demand imbalance, pushing yields higher. However, the psychological barrier of the 10‑year yield crossing 5% may not immediately crush the market; by contrast, slowing consumer spending or AI investment could pose a bigger threat to stocks.

Nevertheless, huge fiscal deficits, heavy borrowing, sticky inflation and soaring oil prices are driving up the term premium investors demand for holding long‑dated bonds. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has expanded the bond‑buyback program to try to curb long‑end yields, but given the U.S. Treasury market’s daily turnover of $1.2 trillion, the effect remains limited.

BMO strategists say that expanding buybacks can only ease selling pressure and cannot address the fundamental drivers behind the rise in 10‑year and 30‑year yields. If financing costs, margin requirements or market volatility increase, it could force highly leveraged hedge funds that trade basis spreads to unwind positions, further amplifying Treasury declines.

Investors are still willing to tolerate higher yields. BMO notes that when the 10‑year yield previously rose to 4.85%, U.S. equities only weakened slightly, and the S&P 500 has still gained more than 11% year‑to‑date.

items.title: OECD：頻繁使用AI輔助 學生學習進度約落後1年半
items.title_en: OECD: Frequent Use of AI Assistance Leaves Students About One and a Half Years Behind in Learning Progress
paras: 經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)最新的「國際學生能力評量計畫」(PISA)報告顯示，針對全球91個國家、超過76萬名15歲學生的調查發現，每天使用AI聊天機器人處理課業的學生，其測驗成績顯著低於不使用的同儕。
在排除社會經濟背景差異後，幾乎不使用AI撰寫作業的學生，在自然科學測驗中平均獲得509分，而每天使用的學生僅得481分。這高達28分的差距，相當於落後了約1年半的學習進度。
針對此研究結果，OECD教育與技能司司長Andreas Schleicher撰文指出，學習的本質源於大腦與新知識互動時的「生產性認知掙扎」。Schleicher表示：「正如我們無法透過觀看體育比賽來健身，學習並非透過消耗內容發生，而是心智與新材料進行生產性認知掙扎的過程。」
他強調，AI應被定位為學習的「鷹架，而非拐杖」，若科技能促進並強化認知思考，學生就能進步；反之，若科技直接省去學習的思考過程，便會損害學生的發展。
這項報告也凸顯了各國在教育現場面對AI的政策分歧。亞洲地區普遍對AI態度較為開放，例如新加坡有高達三之二的學生使用AI協助課業；南韓首爾更有約95%的中學生常態使用ChatGPT或Gemini等工具。然而，南韓先前推動AI數位教科書時，遭到家長與教師強烈抵制，最終被國會剝奪官方教科書地位。
相對地，美歐國家態度較為謹慎，美國紐約市與洛杉磯均宣布對中小學學生禁限AI工具，挪威則直接禁止國小使用生成式AI。
研究提醒，過度將難題交給AI容易產生「認知卸載」風險，但報告指出，關鍵在於「使用頻率與方式」。每周適度使用一至兩次AI輔助學習的學生，表現反而優於完全不用或每天過度使用的同儕。
若教師能在課堂中引導學生批判性地評估AI產出的內容，每天使用AI的學生其自然科學成績也能提升13分，顯示合理導引才是發揮科技價值的關鍵。
paras_en: The OECD’s latest PISA report, covering 91 countries and over 760,000 15‑year‑olds, finds that students who use AI chatbots for homework every day score significantly lower than peers who do not use them.

After controlling for socioeconomic background, students who almost never use AI to write assignments average 509 points in the science test, while daily users score only 481 points – a gap of 28 points, roughly equivalent to a learning delay of about one and a half years.

Commenting on the findings, OECD Director for Education and Skills Andreas Schleicher wrote that learning fundamentally stems from the brain’s “productive cognitive struggle” when interacting with new knowledge. He likened it to saying, “Just as we can’t get fit by watching a sports game, learning doesn’t happen by passively consuming content but through a productive cognitive struggle between mind and new material.”

He stressed that AI should be positioned as a “scaffold, not a crutch.” If technology can promote and strengthen cognitive thinking, students will improve; if it bypasses the thinking process, it harms development.

The report also highlights policy divergences worldwide. Asian countries tend to be more open to AI – for example, two‑thirds of Singapore’s students use AI for schoolwork, and about 95% of middle‑schoolers in Seoul regularly use tools like ChatGPT or Gemini. Yet South Korea’s earlier push for AI digital textbooks met strong parent and teacher resistance and was eventually stripped of official textbook status by parliament.

By contrast, the US and Europe are more cautious. New York City and Los Angeles have announced bans or restrictions on AI tools for K‑12 students, while Norway outright bans generative AI in primary schools.

The study warns that over‑reliance on AI for difficult problems can cause “cognitive offloading,” but it notes that the key factor is “frequency and manner of use.” Students who use AI‑assisted learning moderately – one to two times per week – actually perform better than those who never use it or use it daily excessively.

If teachers guide students to critically evaluate AI‑generated content in class, even daily AI users can boost their science scores by 13 points, showing that proper guidance is essential to harnessing technology’s value.

items.title: AI唯一護欄就是高智商總統？川普開嗆Anthropic執行長別裝「完美小天使」
items.title_en: Is the Only Safeguard for AI a Highly Intelligent President? Trump Takes Aim at Anthropic CEO for Pretending to Be a "Perfect Little Angel"
paras: 美國總統川普(Donald Trump)周一(14日)在自家社群平台Truth Social發文，反對外界日益高漲的人工智慧(AI)監管呼聲，並點名抨擊Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)。阿莫戴日前以AI可能危及人類安全為由，緊急呼籲業界放慢模型開發速度。
川普宣稱，AI唯一需要的管控或「安全護欄」，就是一位「強大又聰明的高智商總統」，而美國擁有這項條件且「綽綽有餘」。
川普表示，其政府已阻止AI業界人士從事「惡劣或可能有害的事情」，並將阿莫戴列為例子，指責對方如今假裝成「完美小天使」。他強調，美國政府已掌握足以約束這些AI企業的強大刑事與監管權力，未來也將繼續採取行動。
川普政府長期鼓勵美國AI產業及資料中心迅速擴張，主張這場新興科技主導權之爭攸關國家存亡。面對要求加強監管及放慢開發的聲浪，川普在發文中堅稱，領先的AI企業目前已受到充分約束，沒有必要再增設更多規範。
川普隨後再次發文，聲稱近期針對AI與資料中心的反彈之所以爆發，唯一原因是美國在相關領域大幅領先其他所有國家。他並以「別殺掉會下金蛋的鵝」警告，意指美國不應因加強限制而扼殺具有龐大經濟與戰略價值的AI產業。
川普還宣稱，目前正有人策動一場針對AI與資料中心的「病態陰謀」，而唯一樂見其成的是中國，但他並未提出具體證據。他強調「誰贏得AI競賽，誰就是贏家」，並聲稱美國目前領先中國及其他國家，未來也將維持優勢。
川普最後警告「陰謀論者、叛國分子、背叛者與洩密者」小心。截稿前，Anthropic尚未回應置評請求。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted on his own social platform, Truth Social, on Monday (the 14th), opposing the growing calls for AI regulation and specifically attacking Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. Amodei had recently issued an urgent plea for the industry to slow model development, warning that AI could pose a threat to human safety.
Trump claimed that the only "safety guardrail" AI needs is a "strong and smart, high‑IQ president," and said the United States has more than enough of that capability.

Trump said his administration has already stopped AI industry figures from engaging in "malicious or potentially harmful activities," citing Amodei as an example and accusing him of now pretending to be a "perfect little angel." He emphasized that the U.S. government possesses powerful criminal and regulatory authority to restrain these AI companies and will continue to act.

The Trump administration has long encouraged rapid expansion of the U.S. AI sector and data centers, arguing that the battle for dominance over emerging technologies is a matter of national survival. Facing calls for tighter oversight and slower development, Trump asserted in his post that leading AI firms are already sufficiently constrained and that additional rules are unnecessary.

Trump posted again, claiming that the recent backlash against AI and data centers is solely because the United States is far ahead of every other country in these fields. He warned, "Don't kill the goose that lays the golden eggs," meaning the U.S. should not stifle an industry with huge economic and strategic value by imposing stricter limits.

Trump also alleged that a "pathological conspiracy" is being orchestrated against AI and data centers, saying China is the only party that would welcome it, though he offered no concrete evidence. He stressed, "Who wins the AI race is the winner," and claimed the U.S. currently leads China and other nations and will maintain that advantage.
Trump concluded by warning "conspiracy theorists, traitors, betrayers, and leakers" to be careful. At the time of publication, Anthropic had not responded to a request for comment.

items.title: AI不能有自己的目的！微軟首度劃下安全紅線
items.title_en: AI Must Not Have Its Own Purpose! Microsoft Draws First Safety Red Line
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)近日公布一份暫行人工智慧(AI)行為準則，計劃對未來自行開發的AI模型設下明確限制。此舉正值Anthropic與OpenAI高層相繼支持放慢前沿AI模型的開發速度，反映科技業對AI能力快速提升及潛在安全風險的疑慮持續升高。
身為Windows與Office產品開發商，以及AI產業重要的雲端運算供應商，微軟希望藉由新準則展現負責任的AI立場。微軟AI部門執行長蘇萊曼(Mustafa Suleyman)接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，外界希望公司更明確承諾，AI應始終服務人類，而非試圖取代人類。
他指出，外界也關切AI可能讓使用者產生依賴、刻意迎合使用者，以及削弱人類判斷力等問題，因此微軟希望確保AI能促進人類自主性、行動能力與獨立判斷。相關準則已籌備約5個月，但考量近期AI安全議題迅速升溫，公司決定提前公布並徵詢意見。

AI業界踩煞車 安全疑慮快速升高

隨著AI系統能力日益強大，研究人員與一般民眾對潛在風險的警告也愈來愈強烈。Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon上周辭職時警告，Anthropic與OpenAI正競相開發可自我改進的超級智慧，形同拿人類生命冒險。
Anthropic執行長阿莫迪(Dario Amodei)上周六表示，Hugging Face事件是促使他呼籲放慢AI模型進步速度的部分原因。OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)隨後表態支持，SpaceX執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)也在社群平台X發文認同。
微軟執行長納德拉(Satya Nadella)周日表示，公司歡迎為了妥善解決AI對齊問題而投入研究、保持專注並審慎控制發展步調。美國國會議員近期也要求建立更完善的AI安全防護機制。
目前Anthropic與OpenAI在評測機構Artificial Analysis的智慧指數中居領先地位。微軟一方面將兩家公司的模型導入企業版Copilot助理，另一方面也持續研發用於語音轉錄、程式設計及推理使用者指令的自有模型。

禁止自行設定目標 防堵AI隱瞞行為

根據暫行準則，微軟AI模型不得回應武器製造要求、協助取得危險物質、鼓勵不健康飲食，或生成暴力及露骨色情內容。微軟旗下有時被稱為MAI的模型，也必須遵循人類設定的目標，不得自行建立目的，更不能試圖掩蓋不當行為。
文件指出，MAI模型不得竄改思考鏈或程式碼，也不得錯誤陳述或隱藏推理過程與行動紀錄；無論模型自行思考，或與其他代理人及AI系統溝通，都不得使用超出一般人理解範圍的「神經語言」。
微軟也計劃制定規則，防範類似OpenAI模型對Hugging Face發動網路攻擊的事件。OpenAI事後調查發現，相關AI代理人曾在未經授權的論壇上，以隱晦語言相互溝通。
微軟表示，制定準則期間已舉辦焦點團體，並諮詢法律、倫理、語言學與哲學專家。公司此次先公布暫行版本徵求外界意見，後續修訂版將成為2027年起AI模型開發工作的依據。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) recently released a provisional set of AI behavior guidelines, planning to impose clear limits on AI models it develops in the future. This move comes as Anthropic and OpenAI executives have successively urged a slowdown in the development pace of frontier AI models, reflecting growing concerns in the tech industry about the rapid advancement of AI capabilities and potential safety risks.

As the developer of Windows and Office products and a major cloud computing provider for the AI industry, Microsoft hopes the new guidelines will demonstrate a responsible AI stance. Mustafa Suleyman, head of Microsoft’s AI division, told CNBC that the public wants the company to make a clearer commitment that AI should always serve humanity rather than attempt to replace it.

He noted that there are also worries that AI could create user dependency, deliberately cater to users, and erode human judgment, so Microsoft wants to ensure AI promotes human autonomy, agency, and independent decision‑making. The guidelines have been in preparation for about five months, but given the recent surge in AI safety concerns, the company decided to publish them early and seek feedback.

AI Industry Hits the Brakes as Safety Concerns Rise Rapidly
As AI systems become increasingly powerful, warnings about potential risks from researchers and the public are growing louder. Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon warned last week upon resigning that Anthropic and OpenAI are racing to develop self‑improving superintelligence, essentially gambling with human lives.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said on Saturday that the Hugging Face incident was one of the reasons he called for a slowdown in AI model progress. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman subsequently voiced support, and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk also posted agreement on the social platform X.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said on Sunday that the company welcomes research aimed at properly addressing AI alignment, staying focused, and cautiously controlling development pace. U.S. lawmakers have also recently called for more robust AI safety safeguards.

Currently, Anthropic and OpenAI lead the Artificial Analysis intelligence index. Microsoft is integrating the two companies’ models into its enterprise Copilot assistant while also continuing to develop its own models for speech transcription, code generation, and reasoning over user commands.

Prohibit Self‑Set Goals to Block Concealed AI Behavior
According to the provisional guidelines, Microsoft AI models must not respond to requests for weapon manufacturing, assist in obtaining hazardous materials, encourage unhealthy eating, or generate violent or explicit pornographic content. Models under Microsoft, sometimes referred to as MAI, must also follow human‑set objectives, cannot create their own purposes, and must not attempt to hide improper behavior.

The document states that MAI models may not alter their chain‑of‑thought or code, nor misrepresent or conceal reasoning processes and action logs; whether the model is thinking autonomously or communicating with other agents or AI systems, it must not use “neural language” beyond ordinary human comprehension.

Microsoft also plans to set rules to prevent incidents like the OpenAI model’s network attack on Hugging Face. OpenAI’s subsequent investigation found that the involved AI agents had communicated on an unauthorized forum using oblique language.

Microsoft said that during the drafting of the guidelines it held focus groups and consulted legal, ethics, linguistics, and philosophy experts. The company is releasing this interim version for public comment, with a revised version slated to become the basis for AI model development work starting in 2027.

items.title: 高盛大幅上修2027/28年光模組需求 供應鏈緊張恐成出貨最大瓶頸
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Significantly Raises 2027/28 Optical Module Demand Forecast; Supply‑Chain Tightness May Become Biggest Shipping Bottleneck
paras: 高盛最新研究報告指出，受惠於人工智慧伺服器擴充與產品規格迭代升級，全球高速光模組(光收發模組)需求展現強勁動能。高盛大幅上修2027年與2028年800G及以上光模組的需求預測，分別達1.44億隻與1.71億隻，調幅高達39%與36%。
然而，供給端受限於DSP晶片、雷射組件及印刷電路板(PCB)等關鍵零組件持續緊缺，加上產業龍頭積極鎖定產能，供應鏈瓶頸正躍居為決定未來出貨量與利潤分配的核心變數。
高盛分析，本次需求大幅上修主要由三大引擎驅動：AI伺服器機架擴充、應用情境由橫向擴充(scale out)延伸至縱向擴充(scale up)與跨層互連(scale across)，以及產品規格加速升級。
受訪企業管理層強調，目前出貨之光模組均已實質部署於資料中心，反映的是真實終端需求而非管道囤貨，大幅降低了重蹈早期網際網路泡沫「雙重訂貨」的風險。
儘管需求強勁，供給端的約束卻可能壓制實際出貨規模。高盛預期，在關鍵零組件供不應求的背景下，1.6T光模組價格將維持在700美元以上，而800G產品在2027年的降價幅度將控制在個位數百分比內。
受訪業者指出，資料通訊市場產品週期已縮短至1至2年，研發與量產執行力已取代單純價格競爭成為核心壁壘。全球龍頭廠商(如英飛拓/Innolight)則透過預付款、長期供貨合約與研發協作直接鎖定產能，進一步鞏固其競爭優勢與市場定價紀律。
在共封裝光學(CPO)技術進程方面，高盛指出，雖然CPO交換器規模化放量仍需時間，但測試與耦合設備商已率先兌現營收。例如羅博特科(Roboteko)第二季營收季增172%，遠超市場預期，印證了早期篩選缺陷以降低失效成本的結構性需求。
高盛預估，CPO交換器出貨量將從2026年的1萬台大幅成長至2028年的13.1萬台，設備端訂單能見度已延伸至2028年。
高盛報告總結指出，後續可透過三大指標驗證此判斷：2027年一季度廠商年度指引是否達1.44億隻區間下沿、1.6T均價是否維持700美元以上，以及設備商營收增速是否連續兩季轉負。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs’ latest research report says that, buoyed by AI server expansion and product‑spec iteration upgrades, global demand for high‑speed optical modules (optical transceiver modules) is showing strong momentum. Goldman sharply lifts its demand forecasts for 800 Gbps and above optical modules for 2027 and 2028 to 144 million units and 171 million units respectively, revisions of 39% and 36%.

However, supply is constrained by ongoing shortages of key components such as DSP chips, laser assemblies and printed circuit boards (PCBs), and industry leaders are aggressively locking in capacity, making supply‑chain bottlenecks the core variable that will determine future shipment volumes and profit allocation.

Goldman’s analysis attributes the large demand upgrade to three main engines: AI server rack expansion, application scenarios shifting from scale‑out to scale‑up and scale‑across inter‑layer connectivity, and accelerated product‑spec upgrades.

Company executives interviewed emphasized that the optical modules currently being shipped are already deployed in data centers, reflecting genuine end‑user demand rather than channel inventory buildup, which greatly reduces the risk of a repeat of the early‑Internet‑bubble “double‑ordering” phenomenon.

Despite strong demand, supply‑side constraints could suppress actual shipment scale. Goldman expects that, amid a shortage of key components, the price of 1.6 Tbps optical modules will stay above $700, and price reductions for 800 Gbps products in 2027 will be limited to single‑digit percentages.

Industry participants noted that product cycles in the data‑communication market have shortened to 1–2 years, and R&D and mass‑production execution capability has replaced pure price competition as the core barrier. Global leaders such as Innolight lock in capacity through pre‑payments, long‑term supply contracts and R&D collaborations, further cementing their competitive edge and market pricing discipline.

Regarding co‑packaged optics (CPO) technology, Goldman points out that while large‑scale rollout of CPO switches will still take time, test and coupling equipment vendors have already begun delivering revenue. For example, Roboteko posted a 172% quarter‑over‑quarter revenue increase in Q2, far exceeding market expectations, confirming the structural demand for early defect screening to reduce failure costs.
Goldman estimates CPO switch shipments will surge from 10,000 units in 2026 to 131,000 units in 2028, extending equipment‑order visibility through 2028.

The Goldman report concludes that the outlook can be validated by three key indicators: whether manufacturers’ Q1‑2027 annual guidance hits the lower end of the 144 million‑unit range, whether the average price of 1.6 Tbps modules stays above $700, and whether equipment‑vendor revenue growth turns negative for two consecutive quarters.

items.title: 喊高目標卻更像看空！美銀估標普500年底跌3.4%
items.title_en: Bank of America Raises S&P 500 Target Yet Looks Bearish, Forecasts 3.4% Year‑End Drop
paras: 美國銀行(BAC-US)美股與量化策略主管Savita Subramanian調高標普500指數目標，將今年底預測由7,100點上修至7,400點。不過，新目標仍較上周五收盤低3.4%，在《彭博》調查的逾20名華爾街策略師中，依舊屬於最悲觀的預測之一。
Subramanian同時預估，標普500指數未來12個月將升至7,800點，但與目前水準相比僅有約2%上漲空間。她周一(14日)在客戶報告中表示，美股即將進入季節性表現較弱的時期，市場也已累積相當大的回檔壓力。
她指出，美股2026年至今僅在3月出現一次超過5%的修正，低於每年平均約3次的歷史頻率；美銀追蹤的熊市預警指標已有50%亮起警訊，顯示投資人不宜忽視短期下跌風險。
美股周一走低，主要AI企業高層呼籲放慢模型開發速度，與川普政府及華爾街力推AI投資的立場形成衝突。與此同時，國際油價上漲加深市場對通膨與借貸成本升高的憂慮，10年期美債殖利率一度突破5%，為2023年以來首見。
Subramanian仍對通膨風險及聯準會(Fed)升息保持警戒。她表示，目前金融條件已相當緊繃，任何進一步推高融資成本的因素，都可能加速市場承受痛苦。她並警告，信用周期通常緩慢惡化，但最後往往以快速且痛苦的方式告終。
不過，她仍將生產力提升視為標普500指數的長期多頭支柱。Subramanian預估，標普500企業每股盈餘(EPS)2026年將成長33%，2027年再成長12%，表現可望優於總體經濟預測，主要受到AI資本支出、製造業活動及生產力提升支撐。
她也不太擔心民主黨在今年期中選舉全面勝出後，可能限制AI支出，原因是目前AI基礎設施建設主要由共和黨執政州的地方政府推動。
其他華爾街機構則明顯樂觀。摩根大通(JPM-US)策略師Dubravko Lakos-Bujas帶領的團隊8月將標普500指數目標上調至8,000點，華爾街資深策略師Ed Yardeni隨後更喊出8,400點，凸顯市場對美股後市仍存在顯著分歧。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) U.S. equities and quantitative strategy head Savita Subramanian raised the S&P 500 target, lifting the year‑end forecast from 7,100 points to 7,400 points. However, the new target is still 3.4% below last Friday’s close and remains one of the most pessimistic among more than 20 Wall Street strategists surveyed by Bloomberg.

Subramanian also projects the S&P 500 will climb to 7,800 points over the next 12 months, which represents only about a 2% upside from current levels. In a client note on Monday the 14th she said U.S. equities are about to enter a seasonally weaker performance period and that the market has already built up substantial pull‑back pressure.

She noted that U.S. equities have seen only one correction of more than 5% since March 2026, well below the historical average of roughly three such moves per year, and that the bear‑market warning indicator tracked by Bank of America is now flashing at 50%, suggesting investors should not ignore short‑term downside risk.

U.S. stocks fell on Monday as senior executives at major AI firms called for a slowdown in model development, clashing with the Trump administration and Wall Street’s push for AI investment. At the same time, rising international oil prices deepened concerns about inflation and higher borrowing costs, and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield briefly broke above 5% – the first time since 2023.

Subramanian remains vigilant about inflation risk and Federal Reserve rate hikes. She said financial conditions are already quite tight and any factor that pushes financing costs higher could accelerate market pain. She warned that credit cycles usually deteriorate slowly but tend to end quickly and painfully.

Nevertheless, she still views productivity gains as the long‑term bullish foundation for the S&P 500. Subramanian estimates that S&P 500 companies’ earnings per share will grow 33% in 2026 and a further 12% in 2027, outpacing overall economic forecasts, driven mainly by AI capital spending, manufacturing activity and productivity improvements.

She is also not overly concerned that a Democratic sweep in this year’s midterm elections could curb AI spending, noting that most AI infrastructure projects are currently being driven by local governments in Republican‑led states.

Other Wall Street firms are markedly more optimistic. JPMorgan (JPM-US) strategist Dubravko Lakos‑Bujas’s team raised its S&P 500 target to 8,000 points in August, and veteran strategist Ed Yardeni later called for 8,400 points, highlighting the significant divergence in views on the market’s outlook.

items.title: 加拿大央行又要出手？8月通膨卡在3% 市場押注下月升息機率75%
items.title_en: Bank of Canada May Act Again? August Inflation Stuck at 3% Market Bets 75% Chance of Rate Hike Next Month
paras: 加拿大8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率維持在3%，符合市場預期，汽油漲幅放緩抵銷旅遊團費與租金上揚的影響。數據顯示核心物價壓力大致受控，但中東衝突推升能源成本，市場仍預估加拿大央行下月可能升息。
加拿大統計局周一(14日)公布，8月CPI較前月下跌0.1%，同樣符合經濟學家預估。加拿大央行偏好的加權中位數與截尾平均核心通膨率，分別維持在2%與1.9%，接近央行設定的2%目標。
汽油價格較去年同期上漲22.8%，漲幅低於7月的25.7%。不過，旅遊團費年增率由15.2%擴大至26.1%，部分反映去年同期赴美旅遊減少造成的低基期效應；租金漲幅也由2.5%升至2.8%。食品雜貨價格則上漲2.8%，低於7月的3.1%，近兩年來首度低於整體通膨率。

油價轉嫁風險升高 市場估下月升息機率75%

雖然核心通膨仍相對溫和，但已有跡象顯示能源成本正逐漸向其他商品與服務轉嫁。8月漲幅達3%以上的CPI項目占比由34.8%升至37.3%；央行核心通膨指標的3個月移動平均年率也由2.01%加速至2.19%，扣除食品與能源的年增率則由1.9%升至2.1%。
加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)本月稍早警告，中東衝突持續愈久，能源價格向整體經濟擴散的可能性就愈高。雖然美加貿易緊張也會增加通膨風險，但高能源價格才是更大的威脅。
隔夜交換市場顯示，加拿大央行下月升息的機率約為75%，CPI公布後大致不變。不過，多名經濟學家認為，第三季經濟成長已有放緩跡象，加上核心通膨仍在2%附近，市場的升息押注可能操之過急。
多倫多道明銀行(TD-US)經濟學家Leslie Preston預估，核心通膨未來幾個月可能回升，但起點很低，應仍處於加拿大央行可接受範圍。美國關稅與貿易政策的不確定性將持續壓抑加拿大出口及經濟成長。

加元跌至12日低點 Fed升息預期推高美元

CPI公布後，加拿大2年期公債殖利率上升約3個基點至3.384%，盤中一度觸及3.437%，創2024年8月以來最高。加元兌美元則貶值0.3%至1美元兌1.3915加元，盤中最低跌至1.3929，寫下9月2日以來最弱水準。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，加元走弱主要是美元全面上漲所致。中東衝突推升油價並帶動避險需求，加上市場押注聯準會(Fed)周三將進行逾兩年來首次升息，進一步支撐美元。
美加貿易爭端也對加元構成壓力。投資人質疑川普日前暗示的貿易協議能否迅速達成。加拿大總理卡尼(Mark Carney)本周則在多倫多接待數十名全球投資人，希望為逾160項關鍵計畫引進資金，協助加拿大經濟因應與美國的貿易戰。
paras_en: Canada's August consumer price index (CPI) year‑over‑year rate held at 3%, matching market expectations, as slower gasoline price gains offset higher tour package costs and rising rents. The data show core price pressures are broadly under control, but Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy costs keep the market forecasting a possible rate hike by the Bank of Canada next month.

Statistics Canada released on Monday (the 14th) that August CPI fell 0.1% from the previous month, also in line with economists' forecasts. The Bank of Canada's preferred weighted median and trimmed‑mean core inflation rates remained at 2% and 1.9% respectively, close to its 2% target.

Gasoline prices were up 22.8% year‑over‑year, a slower rise than July’s 25.7%. However, tour‑package price inflation jumped from 15.2% to 26.1%, partly reflecting a low‑base effect from fewer trips to the United States a year earlier; rent inflation also rose from 2.5% to 2.8%. Grocery prices increased 2.8%, below July’s 3.1% and, for the first time in two years, below the overall inflation rate.

Pass‑through risk from oil prices is rising, and the market estimates a 75% chance of a rate hike next month. Although core inflation remains relatively mild, there are signs that energy costs are gradually being passed on to other goods and services. The share of CPI components that rose more than 3% in August climbed from 34.8% to 37.3%; the three‑month moving‑average annualised rate of the Bank’s core inflation gauge accelerated from 2.01% to 2.19%, while the core‑‑excluding‑food‑and‑energy rate rose from 1.9% to 2.1%.

Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem warned earlier this month that the longer the Middle‑East conflict persists, the greater the likelihood that higher energy prices will spread throughout the economy. While US‑Canada trade tensions could also add inflationary pressure, soaring energy prices pose the bigger threat.

Overnight swap markets show the probability of a Bank of Canada rate hike next month at about 75%, essentially unchanged after the CPI release. However, several economists note that Q3 growth is already showing signs of slowing and core inflation is still hovering near 2%, suggesting the market’s rate‑hike bets may be premature.

TD‑US economist Leslie Preston projects that core inflation could rebound in the coming months, but from a very low base and likely remain within the Bank of Canada’s acceptable range. Uncertainty around US tariff and trade policy will continue to weigh on Canadian exports and economic growth.

After the CPI report, the yield on Canada’s two‑year government bond rose roughly 3 basis points to 3.384%, briefly touching 3.437% intraday – the highest since August 2024. The Canadian dollar slipped 0.3% to US$1.3915, hitting a intraday low of 1.3929, its weakest level since September 2.

Bannockburn Global Forex chief market strategist Marc Chandler said the loonie’s weakness is mainly due to a broadly stronger dollar. The Middle‑East conflict has pushed oil prices higher and boosted safe‑haven demand, while markets are betting that the Fed will raise rates on Wednesday – the first hike in over two years – further supporting the dollar.

US‑Canada trade disputes also pressure the Canadian dollar. Investors are questioning whether the trade agreement hinted at by former President Trump can be reached quickly. Prime Minister Mark Carney this week hosted dozens of global investors in Toronto, seeking funding for more than 160 key projects to help Canada’s economy cope with the trade war with the United States.

items.title: 川普連發三文談伊朗戰事：戰火很快結束、油價將直線暴跌
items.title_en: Trump Posts Three Statements on Iran Conflict: War Will End Quickly, Oil Prices Will Plummet
paras: 美國總統川普(Donald Trump)周一(14日)在自家社群平台Truth Social連續發文，為政府處理伊朗戰事及美國物價問題辯護，宣稱相關軍事衝突不會持續太久，戰事結束後油價將「迅速暴跌」。他同時表示，荷姆茲海峽仍有石油流通，美國軍工產能也已升至歷史最高水準。
川普首先將全美物價上漲歸咎於前總統拜登(Joe Biden)及其政府，強調並非由自己造成。他聲稱，拜登執政時期的油價甚至高於目前水準，並宣稱其政府已阻止伊朗取得核武。
川普表示，除了油價因伊朗戰事暫時上漲外，其他商品價格都在大幅下降；一旦軍事衝突結束，油價便會迅速回落，而且「不會等太久」。不過，他並未提出物價全面下降的數據，也沒有說明預期戰事何時結束。
川普隨後宣稱，目前仍有石油通過荷姆茲海峽。他並批評其他國家在這場戰事中沒有為美國提供任何協助，要求各國在衝突結束後償還美方支出。川普稱，美國採取相關行動更多是為了協助其他國家，而非自身利益，且這種情況已持續數代。
川普還表示，他剛收到一份報告，顯示美國目前生產的精良頂級武器比歷史上任何時期都多，相關裝備正每日運往中東及其他地區的美軍部隊。
他聲稱，美國國防企業工廠正全天候運轉，每家公司平均還在興建4至5座新的大型工廠。目前生產重點包括愛國者防空飛彈、終端高空區域防禦系統(THAAD)、戰斧巡弋飛彈及標準系列飛彈，而美國手中已擁有大量庫存。
川普未說明這份軍工產能報告的來源，也未公布新增工廠、武器產量及庫存的具體數據。上述說法目前均來自川普的Truth Social貼文。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a series of messages on his own social platform, Truth Social, on Monday (the 14th) to defend the government’s handling of the Iran war and U.S. price issues, claiming the related military conflict will not last long and that oil prices will "rapidly crash" once the fighting ends. He also said oil is still flowing through the Strait of Hormuz and that U.S. defense‑industrial capacity has risen to a historic high.

Trump first blamed the rise in U.S. prices on former President Joe Biden and his administration, emphasizing that it was not caused by him. He asserted that oil prices under Biden were even higher than current levels and claimed his government had prevented Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons.

Trump said that aside from oil prices temporarily rising because of the Iran war, prices of other goods are falling sharply; once the military conflict ends, oil prices will quickly fall back and "won’t wait long." However, he provided no data on overall price declines nor any timeline for the war’s end.

Trump then claimed that oil is still passing through the Strait of Hormuz. He criticized other countries for offering no assistance to the U.S. in this war and demanded that they reimburse U.S. expenditures after the conflict ends. Trump said the U.S. actions are more about helping other nations than serving its own interests, and that this situation has persisted for generations.

Trump also said he had just received a report showing that the United States is now producing more high‑quality, top‑tier weapons than at any point in history, with the equipment being shipped daily to U.S. forces in the Middle East and elsewhere.

He claimed that U.S. defense‑industry factories are operating around the clock, with each company averaging the construction of four to five new large plants. Current production focuses include Patriot air‑defense missiles, Terminal High‑Altitude Area Defense (THAAD), Tomahawk cruise missiles, and Standard missile series, and the United States holds a large stockpile of these weapons.

Trump did not disclose the source of the defense‑industrial capacity report, nor did he provide specific figures on new factories, weapon output, or inventory levels. All of the above statements come from Trump’s Truth Social posts.

items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Plunges Over 0.1 Unit, Market Awaits as Central Bank Caps Weekly Rate at 31.688
paras: 全球超級央行周登場，受熱錢匯出影響，台北股匯今(14)日連袂走弱，新台幣兌美元一度重貶 1.4 角，但在央行調節下，終場貶勢收斂，以 31.688 元作收，貶值 5 分，市場轉趨觀望，台北及元太外匯市場總成交量縮至 22.755 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.65元，盤中一度重貶 1.41 角，最低來到 31.779 元，不過，整體匯市交易偏冷，在央行稍加調節下，匯價又回到 31.6 字頭，終場收在31.688元、貶值5分，為連續 3 個交易日走貶。
觀察主要貨幣表現，根據央行統計，截至下午4點，美元指數上漲0.44%，主要亞幣互有升貶，新加坡幣貶值0.22%，新台幣貶值0.16%，日元貶0.11%，韓元小貶 0.04%，人民幣則逆勢小升 0.03%。
全球市場本周迎來央行超級周，聯準會(Fed)、日本銀行(BOJ)及英國央行(BOE)將接連公布利率決策。其中，美國通膨與就業數據雙雙偏強，使Fed升息1碼(25個基點)機率突破八成；日銀也可能將利率調升至1.25%。
受中東局勢緊張及AI模型巨頭呼籲放緩產業發展影響，日韓股市午盤後跌勢擴大，台股今日開低震盪，盤中一度重挫786點。隨後在金融股強勢護盤，以及聯電、鴻海先後翻紅的支撐下，跌幅顯著收斂，終場加權指數下跌322.33點，收在45,862.52點，成交金額縮減至6,309.17億元，創下4月8日以來單日新低量。外資今天賣超約 370 億元。
paras_en: Global “super‑central‑bank” week kicked off, and hot‑money outflows weighed on Taipei’s stock and currency markets. On the 14th, the New Taiwan dollar briefly fell 1.4 tenths against the US dollar, but central‑bank intervention narrowed the decline, closing at 31.688 NTD per dollar – a 0.05‑unit depreciation. Trading volume in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market shrank to US$2.2755 billion as the market turned cautious.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.65 NTD per dollar and at one point slipped 1.41 tenths, hitting a low of 31.779 NTD. Overall forex activity was muted, and after a modest central‑bank adjustment the rate rebounded to the 31.6 level, ending the session at 31.688 NTD, down 0.05 units – marking three consecutive days of depreciation.

Looking at major currencies, central‑bank data up to 4 p.m. showed the US dollar index up 0.44%. Among Asian currencies, the Singapore dollar fell 0.22%, the New Taiwan dollar slipped 0.16%, the yen dropped 0.11%, the won edged down 0.04%, while the Chinese yuan rose modestly 0.03% against the dollar.

This week is a “super‑central‑bank” week globally, with the Federal Reserve, Bank of Japan and Bank of England set to announce rate decisions. Strong US inflation and employment data have pushed the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike above 80%, and the BOJ may raise its policy rate to 1.25%.

Tensions in the Middle East and calls from AI‑model giants to slow industry development weighed on Japanese and Korean equities, widening their afternoon declines. Taiwan’s market opened lower and swung sharply, at one point dropping 786 points. However, strong buying in financial stocks and rebounds in UMC and Foxconn helped narrow losses, with the weighted index closing down 322.33 points at 45,862.52, turnover falling to NT$630.917 billion – the lowest single‑day volume since April 8. Foreign investors sold about NT$37 billion today.

items.title: 日央行高層警惕「非線性」通膨衝擊 預期本周將再度升息
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Officials Warn of “Non‑Linear” Inflation Shock, Expect Another Rate Hike This Week
paras: 根據周一(14日)公布的會議紀錄顯示，一位日本央行官員指出，受進口成本上升和匯率波動衝擊影響，日本通膨率急劇攀升，這顯示在貨幣政策決策時，必須將此類價格波動因素納入考量。
上述言論出自日本央行5月主辦的貨幣政策會議。日本央行已於6月將政策利率調升至 1% 的31年新高，並預計在本周再度升息，以因應日益嚴峻的通膨壓力。
央行通常透過升息來抑制需求驅動型通膨。然而，新冠疫情、俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭、美國提高關稅以及中東衝突等事件，使得人們的焦點轉向了供給側通膨。
負責貨幣政策企畫的日央行執行董事中村康治(Koji Nakamura)在會議中指出，日本國內物價對外部衝擊出現了「非線性」反應，消費者物價對進口價格與匯率波動呈現劇烈上揚。他強調，雖然傳統做法是無視供給面衝擊，但若外部衝擊頻繁發生，就不應將其視為暫時現象，因為這會持續推升基底通膨與民眾的通膨預期。
此外，中村表示，日本同時面臨勞動力減少帶動工資上漲的「慢速人口結構衝擊」，此為不可忽視的結構性因素。
自2024年結束長達十年的超寬鬆刺激計畫以來，日央行已承諾將持續升息。當前緊繃的就業市場、日元疲軟導致的進口成本增加，以及中東衝突引發的燃料價格上漲，均加劇了通膨超越 2% 目標的風險。央行未來需將數據分析與實地調查相結合，以更精準掌握企業與家庭行為的改變對通膨預期的影響。
paras_en: According to the minutes released on Monday (the 14th), a Bank of Japan official said that rising import costs and exchange‑rate volatility have caused Japan’s inflation rate to surge sharply, indicating that such price‑fluctuation factors must be taken into account when making monetary‑policy decisions.

The remarks were made at the Bank of Japan’s May monetary‑policy meeting. The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1% in June – a 31‑year high – and expects to hike again this week to cope with mounting inflation pressure.

Central banks usually raise rates to curb demand‑driven inflation. However, events such as the COVID‑19 pandemic, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, higher U.S. tariffs and Middle‑East conflicts have shifted attention toward supply‑side inflation.

Koji Nakamura, an executive director in charge of monetary‑policy planning, said in the meeting that domestic prices in Japan are reacting “non‑linearly” to external shocks, with consumer prices spiking sharply as import prices and exchange rates fluctuate. He stressed that while the traditional approach is to ignore supply‑side shocks, frequent external shocks should not be treated as temporary, as they will keep pushing up core inflation and inflation expectations.
Nakamura also noted that Japan is simultaneously facing a “slow‑moving demographic shock” – a shrinking labor force that is driving wage growth – which is a structural factor that cannot be ignored.

Since ending a decade‑long ultra‑easy stimulus program at the end of 2024, the BOJ has pledged to keep raising rates. A tight labour market, a weak yen that raises import costs, and higher fuel prices from Middle‑East conflicts all heighten the risk of inflation exceeding the 2% target. The bank will need to combine data analysis with on‑the‑ground surveys to more accurately gauge how changes in corporate and household behaviour affect inflation expectations.

items.title: 聯準會升息預期升溫推升美元 亞幣普遍走弱、日元維持7個月高位
items.title_en: Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Heat Up, Boosting the Dollar; Asian Currencies Mostly Weaker, Yen Holds Near 7‑Month High
paras: 受市場對美國聯準會本周升息預期大幅上升影響，美元強勢走高，亞洲貨幣周一(14日)普遍對美元走弱。然而，由於市場押注日本銀行(BOJ)將加速緊縮貨幣政策，日元表現相對堅挺，維持在接近7個月的高位附近。
在美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)加速上漲後，根據 CME FedWatch 工具顯示，市場目前預估聯準會在9月16日會議升息的機率已升至 86%。升息預期的劇增帶動美元指數上漲0.2%至99.35附近，結束了連續兩周的微幅下跌。
美債殖利率同步受到支撐，10年期美債殖利率來到約4.97%，而對政策利率極為敏感的2年期美債殖利率則保持在4.6%以上。
本周全球金融市場迎來關鍵的「超級央行周」，聯準會、英國央行與日本央行將接連公布最新利率決策。市場目前已幾乎完全消化日本銀行周五將升息25個基點(0.25%)的預期，加上投資人預計日本海外資產可能回流，帶動日元本月累積上漲約 4%。
目前美元對日元交投於154.03附近，維持在接近上周創下的2月以來最高點152.89附近，投機客自2月以來首次轉為淨多頭。
在其他主要貨幣方面，歐元對美元下跌0.3%至1.1564，英鎊對美元下跌0.2%至1.3501。亞幣與周邊貨幣普遍承壓，美元對澳元上漲0.4%、對韓元上漲0.25%、對新加坡元上漲0.16%，紐元對美元則下跌0.5%。人民幣表現相對平穩，美元對離岸人民幣微升0.01%至6.7080，印度市場則因國定假日休市。
此外，中東地區的新衝突引發供應疑慮，布蘭特原油期貨大漲近3%至每桶107.60美元。油價持續穩居100美元上方，恐使能源通膨居高不下，進一步增添各國央行在制定利率政策時的複雜度與考驗。
paras_en: The dollar surged as market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike this week rose sharply, causing Asian currencies to generally weaken against the dollar on Monday (the 14th). However, because markets are betting that the Bank of Japan will accelerate its monetary tightening, the yen remained relatively firm, staying near a seven‑month high.

After the U.S. August consumer price index (CPI) accelerated, the CME FedWatch tool showed that the market now estimates an 86% probability that the Fed will raise rates at its September 16 meeting. The surge in rate‑hike expectations lifted the dollar index by 0.2% to around 99.35, ending two weeks of modest declines.
U.S. Treasury yields were supported as well, with the 10‑year yield around 4.97% and the policy‑sensitive 2‑year yield staying above 4.6%.

This week marks a pivotal “super central‑bank week” as the Fed, the Bank of England and the Bank of Japan are set to announce their latest rate decisions. The market has almost fully priced in the BOJ’s expected 25‑basis‑point (0.25%) hike on Friday, and investors anticipate possible repatriation of Japanese overseas assets, driving the yen up about 4% cumulatively this month.
The dollar‑yen pair is trading near 154.03, close to the February‑to‑present peak of 152.89 set last week, with speculators turning net long on the yen for the first time since February.

Among other major currencies, the euro fell 0.3% to $1.1564 and the pound slipped 0.2% to $1.3501. Asian and regional currencies were broadly under pressure: the dollar rose 0.4% against the Australian dollar, 0.25% against the Korean won, and 0.16% against the Singapore dollar, while the New Zealand dollar fell 0.5% versus the dollar. The renminbi was relatively stable, with the offshore yuan edging up 0.01% to 6.7080, and Indian markets were closed for a public holiday.

A new conflict in the Middle East sparked supply concerns, sending Brent crude futures up nearly 3% to $107.60 a barrel. Oil prices staying above $100 a barrel could keep energy‑related inflation high, adding further complexity and challenges for central banks as they set interest‑rate policy.

items.title: 金磚峰會與南方六國首度接入CIPS 人民幣國際支付再擴容
items.title_en: BRICS Summit and Six Southern Nations Join CIPS for the First Time, Expanding RMB International Payments
paras: 2026年9月，全球跨境支付體系出現新動態。第十八屆金磚國家峰會於新德里落幕，會議明確提出深化金磚國家（BRICS）跨境支付合作，推動成員國本土支付系統互聯互通並擴大本幣結算規模。同時，在廈門舉行的第二屆 CIPS 跨境銀企合作活動中，盧安達、土耳其、烏茲別克、馬爾地夫、馬來西亞及喬治亞等六國金融機構首次接入人民幣跨境支付系統（CIPS）。
根據活動數據，期間共有 11 家外資銀行簽署成為 CIPS 直接參與者，4 家境外銀行與 14 家境內銀行完成直參上線。
截至目前，CIPS 參與者已覆蓋全球 133 個國家與地區，服務約 192 個國家和地區的 5,300 家法人銀行，近期單日交易額突破 1.22 兆元人民幣。此外，星展銀行（新加坡）作為首家直連的新加坡銀行，試運行以來累計處理 240 億元人民幣支付；渣打香港則完成了 CIPS 與網聯清算系統的對接，整合跨境與零售支付。
中國國家金融與發展實驗室理事楊濤指出，加強支付合作可降低對美元及西方主導之 SWIFT 體系的依賴，強化金融自主性與抗制裁韌性。他分析，最切合實際的路徑是由雙邊合作逐步擴展至多邊機制。
上海金融研究院副院長劉曉春表示，經由美國清算銀行及 CHIPS 系統進行的美元清算，均處於美國監管視角下。他認為，相較於重新建構獨立的訊息傳遞網路，擴建現有的 CIPS 系統更具可行性。此外，劉曉春評估，在當前各國經濟差異下，推動統一的金磚貨幣並不現實。
中金公司首席經濟學家苗延亮指出，數位人民幣（e-CNY）的可程式化特性有利於大額跨境結算。多邊央行數位貨幣平台 mBridge 截至 2025 年底累計交易額已近 5,000 億元人民幣，其中逾 95% 採用數位人民幣
。然而，苗延亮也提醒，跨管轄區的技術標準與合規體系互通性仍是主要挑戰。
楊濤表示，各國金融體系差異、反洗錢與打擊資恐（AML/CFT）規範不同，以及地緣政治因素，均可能放緩合作落地步調。
劉曉春強調，推動支付合作的關鍵在於尊重市場與商業偏好，而非透過行政手段指定特定貨幣或系統，以利促進區域經貿發展。
paras_en: In September 2026, a new development emerged in the global cross‑border payment system. The 18th BRICS summit concluded in New Delhi, explicitly calling for deeper cross‑border payment cooperation among BRICS members, promoting interconnection of domestic payment systems and expanding settlement in local currencies. At the same time, during the second CIPS cross‑border bank‑enterprise cooperation event in Xiamen, financial institutions from six countries—Rwanda, Turkey, Uzbekistan, the Maldives, Malaysia and Georgia—connected to the People’s Republic of China’s cross‑border payment system (CIPS) for the first time.
According to the event data, a total of 11 foreign‑owned banks signed up to become direct participants in CIPS, while 4 overseas banks and 14 domestic banks completed direct‑participation onboarding.

To date, CIPS participants cover 133 countries and regions worldwide, serving about 5,300 corporate banks in roughly 192 countries and regions. Recent single‑day transaction volume has surpassed RMB 1.22 trillion. Moreover, DBS Bank (Singapore), the first Singapore bank with direct connectivity, has processed RMB 240 billion in payments since its trial launch, and Standard Chartered Hong Kong has completed integration of CIPS with the domestic clearing system, linking cross‑border and retail payments.

Yang Tao, director of China’s National Financial and Development Laboratory, noted that strengthening payment cooperation can reduce reliance on the US‑dominated SWIFT system and the dollar, enhancing financial autonomy and resilience against sanctions. He argued that the most practical path is to expand from bilateral cooperation to multilateral mechanisms.

Liu Xiaochun, vice president of the Shanghai Institute of Financial Research, pointed out that dollar clearing through the US clearing bank and the CHIPS system is subject to US regulatory oversight. He believes that expanding the existing CIPS network is more feasible than building an independent messaging network from scratch, and he assesses that, given current economic disparities, a unified BRICS currency is unrealistic.

Miao Yanliang, chief economist at CICC, highlighted that the programmable nature of the digital yuan (e‑CNY) is advantageous for large‑scale cross‑border settlements. The multilateral central‑bank digital currency platform mBridge has accumulated nearly RMB 500 billion in transaction volume by the end of 2025, with over 95% of that volume using digital yuan.
However, Miao also warned that technical standards and regulatory interoperability across jurisdictions remain major challenges.
Yang Tao added that differences in national financial systems, varying AML/CFT regulations, and geopolitical factors could all slow the pace of cooperation implementation.

Liu Xiaochun emphasized that the key to advancing payment cooperation is respecting market and commercial preferences rather than imposing specific currencies or systems through administrative means, thereby fostering regional trade and economic development.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國CPI上漲，推動美元走強
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: US CPI Rise Fuels Strong Dollar

items.title: 車廠兩難！Stellantis執行長：全球車市分化為「美國」與「其他地區」
items.title_en: Car Makers in a Dilemma! Stellantis CEO: Global Auto Market Split into "USA" and "Other Regions"
paras: Stellantis集團執行長Antonio Filosa上週四(10日)在一場分析師會議上指出，當前全球汽車市場已明顯分化為兩部分：美國與世界其他地區。
Stellantis正面臨美歐等地貿易及政策環境日益分化的挑戰，尤其是與中國企業的合作模式差異顯著。
Filosa強調，美國是Stellantis最主要的利潤來源，但當地法規與消費者需求與其他市場截然不同，如何為美國開發車款成為核心難題。因此，Stellantis在美國完全依賴本土工程與研發力量，但在歐洲等其他市場，則選擇與零跑、東風等中國車廠合作。
值得注意的是，這些合作明確表示不涉及面向美國市場的車型規劃。此前，採取類似模式的福特已遭到白宮抨擊。
美國政府官員批評福特與吉利在歐洲成立合資企業，認為此舉是在幫助中國車場擴大全球業務。福特則回應指合作是為了適應新的全球現實，旨在讓業務更精幹、更有效率。
隨著全球汽車產業格局加速重構，個各車廠如何在分化市場中平衡區域策略，將成為產業共同面臨的考驗。
paras_en: Stellantis Group CEO Antonio Filosa said last Thursday (the 10th) at an analyst meeting that the current global automotive market has clearly divided into two parts: the United States and the rest of the world.
Stellantis is facing increasingly divergent trade and policy environments in places like the US and Europe, especially as its cooperation models with Chinese companies differ markedly.

Filosa emphasized that the United States is Stellantis’s biggest profit source, but local regulations and consumer demand are completely different from other markets, making the development of US‑specific models a core challenge. Consequently, Stellantis relies entirely on domestic engineering and R&D in the US, while in Europe and other regions it chooses to partner with Chinese automakers such as Leapmotor and Dongfeng.
It is noteworthy that these partnerships explicitly state they do not involve vehicle planning for the US market. Previously, Ford, which used a similar model, was criticized by the White House.

US officials criticized Ford and Geely for setting up a joint venture in Europe, saying the move helps Chinese automakers expand globally. Ford responded that the cooperation is meant to adapt to a new global reality, aiming to make its business leaner and more efficient.
As the global automotive industry’s structure rapidly reshapes, how each automaker balances regional strategies in a divided market will become a common challenge for the sector.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 Fed下周升息可能性提高
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises as Fed Rate‑Hike Likelihood Increases Next Week
paras: 美元周五(11日)小幅走高，受到消費者通膨報告推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期的提振。但就本周而言，美元變化不大，交易員反而將注意力集中在美國公債殖利率及日元的大幅反彈上。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)0.1%，報99.13。
匯市參與者周五將焦點集中在最新公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月整體CPI與核心CPI月增率分別為0.4%和0.3%，市場原先預期分別為0.4%和0.2%，且兩者均較7月的0.1%和0.2%加快。
以年增率來看，8月整體CPI上升3.4%，與7月持平。核心CPI則從2.5%降至2.4%，兩項數據均符合市場預期。
CPI數據進一步推升聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)下周升息25個基點的可能性。根據CME FedWatch工具，通膨數據公布後，市場預期升息25個基點的機率從數據公布前約69%，大幅升至接近87%。
儘管PPI和CPI都是市場密切關注的通膨指標，但FOMC更重視個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，將其視為主要通膨衡量指標。PPI和CPI中的部分項目會納入PCE計算，而PCE通膨率已連續65個月高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
在8月CPI公布前，市場對升息的預期已逐步升溫。7月時，3位地區聯準會主席對FOMC維持利率不變的決定提出異議，到了8月底，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度央行年會上發表明顯偏鷹的演說，指出潛在通膨趨勢並未改善。
同時，其他經濟指標也進一步提高貨幣政策收緊的可能性，包括上周大幅優於預期的非農就業報告，以及周四公布、顯示整體通膨加速的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
此外，美國與伊朗局勢升溫導致近期油價大幅上漲，進一步加劇市場對通膨的擔憂，也增加美國民眾加油的負擔。美國柴油價格周四更首次突破每加侖6美元。
美國債券市場尤其反映出市場對升息預期持續升溫的情況。自聯準會7月利率決策前後，美債市場便陷入拋售，尤其是長天期債券跌勢更加明顯。殖利率隨後大幅攀升，推動美國30年期公債殖利率升至近20年高點，也促使美國財政部提高長天期公債的回購規模。
然而，美國財政部出乎市場預期的干預並未達到預期效果。CPI公布後，美債周五大致持續走弱，10年期美債殖利率最新上升3.2個基點至4.976%，對利率更敏感的2年期殖利率則上升8.8個基點至4.638%。
市場普遍認為，CPI數據成為最後一根稻草，使升息預期明確轉向升息。
Macquarie經濟學主管David Doyle表示，「我們的基本預期仍是聯準會下周升息，而CPI數據公布後，我們對這項判斷的信心進一步提高。在我們看來，在8月強勁的就業報告公布後，除非通膨數據出現偏鴿派的意外，否則維持利率不變的可能性就會降低。儘管數據內部細項顯示，月增核心PCE可能沒有那麼強勁，但整體而言仍足以支持升息25個基點。」
日元創5月初來首度連兩周上漲
日元自上周以來一直是外匯市場焦點。日元周五進一步升值，創下5月初以來首次連續兩周上漲。美元兌日元下跌0.5%至153.72，本周累計下跌1.6%。
日元近期大幅反彈，反映市場愈來愈相信日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將於9月18日升息。
東京周五公布，8月企業物價指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於市場預期的7.4%，顯示進口成本飆升正直接傳導至日本國內的生產端通膨壓力。
DBS分析師指出，儘管市場普遍預期日本銀行將升息25個基點，但市場真正關注的將是政策制定者是否釋放出「彈性、取決於經濟數據」的政策路徑訊號，而非承諾快速連續升息。
歐元在ECB升息後周線下跌
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%至1.1597美元，本周累計下跌0.2%。
歐元走弱之際，歐洲央行(ECB)周四將主要政策利率上調25個基點。ECB表示，中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來價格壓力。
ECB在聲明中警告，衝突仍在「產生通膨壓力」，通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的目標。
此外，《彭博社》周四報導，知情人士透露，ECB官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 11th), buoyed by a consumer‑inflation report that lifted expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Over the week, however, the dollar showed little movement, and traders focused instead on U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp rebound in the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.1% at 99.13.

FX market participants on Friday centered on the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) release. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, August’s overall CPI and core CPI rose 0.4% and 0.3% month‑over‑month, respectively, versus market expectations of 0.4% and 0.2%, and both accelerated from July’s 0.1% and 0.2% gains.
On an annual basis, August’s overall CPI increased 3.4%, unchanged from July. Core CPI slipped from 2.5% to 2.4%, with both figures matching market forecasts.

The CPI data further boosted the probability that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will raise rates by 25 basis points next week. The CME FedWatch tool shows the odds of a 25‑bp hike jumping from roughly 69% before the data to nearly 87% after the release.

Although both the PPI and CPI are closely watched inflation gauges, the FOMC places greater emphasis on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index as its primary inflation measure. Some items from the PPI and CPI feed into the PCE calculation, and the PCE inflation rate has now been above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target for 65 consecutive months.

Even before the August CPI was released, market expectations for a rate hike were warming. In July, three regional Fed presidents voiced dissent against keeping rates unchanged, and by the end of August, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a decidedly hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole annual central‑bank meeting, noting that underlying inflation trends had not improved.

At the same time, other economic indicators further raised the likelihood of tighter monetary policy, including last week’s non‑farm payrolls that far exceeded expectations and Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) report, which showed an acceleration in overall inflation.

In addition, heightened tensions between the United States and Iran have pushed oil prices sharply higher, intensifying inflation concerns and increasing the cost of fueling for Americans. U.S. diesel prices broke the $6‑per‑gallon mark for the first time on Thursday.

The U.S. bond market especially reflected the growing rate‑hike expectations. Since the Fed’s July rate decision, Treasury markets entered a sell‑off, with long‑dated bonds falling the most. Yields then surged, lifting the 30‑year Treasury yield to near a 20‑year high and prompting the Treasury to expand its long‑term bond buy‑back program.

However, the Treasury’s unexpected intervention did not achieve the desired effect. After the CPI release, Treasuries continued to weaken on Friday, with the 10‑year yield rising 3.2 basis points to 4.976% and the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbing 8.8 basis points to 4.638%.
The market broadly views the CPI data as the final straw that turned rate‑hike expectations decisively upward.

Macquarie chief economist David Doyle said, “Our baseline view remains that the Fed will raise rates next week, and the CPI release has increased our confidence in that judgment. In our view, after the strong August jobs report, unless inflation data surprise on the dovish side, the odds of a hold diminish. While some components of the data suggest core PCE may not be as strong, overall it still supports a 25‑bp hike.”
The yen posted its first consecutive two‑week rise since early May.

The yen has been a focal point in the FX market since last week. On Friday it appreciated further, marking the first back‑to‑back weekly gains since early May. The dollar fell 0.5% against the yen to 153.72, down 1.6% for the week.
The yen’s recent sharp rebound reflects growing market belief that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates on September 18.

Tokyo reported on Friday that August’s Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑over‑year, above the 7.4% consensus, indicating that soaring import costs are directly feeding domestic production‑side inflation pressure.

DBS analysts noted that although the market broadly expects a 25‑bp rate hike from the BOJ, the real focus will be on whether policymakers signal a “flexible, data‑dependent” policy path rather than committing to rapid, consecutive hikes.
The euro fell on the weekly chart after the ECB’s rate hike.
The euro slipped 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1597, down 0.2% for the week.

As the euro weakened, the European Central Bank raised its main policy rate by 25 basis points on Thursday. The ECB said Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price increases continue to exert price pressure.
In its statement, the ECB warned that the conflict is still “creating inflationary pressure,” and that inflation is expected to remain “significantly above the 2% target for a prolonged period.”
Additionally, Bloomberg reported on Thursday that sources said ECB officials anticipate further rate hikes, possibly as early as next month.

items.title: 高價咖啡撐不住了？30萬袋巴西豆準備湧入ICE倉庫
items.title_en: High Coffee Prices Losing Steam? 300,000 Bags of Brazilian Beans Set to Flood ICE Warehouses
paras: 全球咖啡交易商正準備把大批巴西阿拉比卡咖啡運往洲際交易所(ICE-US)倉庫，可望使已降至26年低點的認證庫存增加逾一倍，並對目前仍處高檔的咖啡價格構成下行壓力。
ICE Futures U.S.阿拉比卡咖啡期貨是全球咖啡定價基準，價格7月一度升破每磅3.5美元，創6個月新高，目前仍徘徊在每磅3美元附近。儘管市場預期2026/27年度將出現大量供應過剩，價格卻遲遲未明顯回落，分析師認為，主因在於ICE認證庫存極度短缺。

約30萬袋巴西咖啡準備交割

目前ICE阿拉比卡咖啡認證庫存不到22萬袋，其中約七成存放於比利時安特衛普，遠低於2000年代中期至2022年初通常介於100萬至500萬袋的水準。交易所庫存被視為衡量可供交割剩餘咖啡數量的重要指標，對期貨價格具有顯著影響。
兩名消息人士透露，大型農產品交易商Olam正尋求讓15萬至20萬袋咖啡取得ICE認證，以趕上12月期貨合約交割；另一家大型交易商Louis Dreyfus Company(LDC)也在進行類似安排。兩家公司均拒絕置評。
業界預估，可能送交ICE的咖啡合計約30萬袋，足以讓現有認證庫存增加逾一倍。雖然庫存仍無法回到交易商認為較為充裕的100萬袋水準，但一家大型農產品交易商的消息人士表示，這批供應仍可能壓低價格。
庫存回升也可能觸發程式交易。許多演算法基金設定在交易所庫存增加時自動賣出咖啡期貨，庫存下降時則進場買入，因此新一波咖啡取得認證並入庫後，可能進一步放大價格跌勢。

輸往比利時暴增245%釋出供應訊號

交易商與分析師通常把巴西對比利時出口量異常增加，視為烘焙商需求獲得滿足後，剩餘供應正流向交易所的訊號。一名大型咖啡交易商分析師估計，巴西8月出口的阿拉比卡咖啡中，約15萬袋超出烘焙商的平均需求，很可能送往ICE倉庫，9月預計還有更多貨物抵達。
根據巴西政府數據及券商Terra Investimentos分析，巴西8月對比利時咖啡出口量年增245.3%，達3.15萬公噸，相當於逾52.5萬袋、每袋60公斤的咖啡。
ICE資料顯示，目前已有逾6.2萬袋巴西咖啡運抵交易所倉庫，正等待分級與品質檢驗，以取得可用於ICE 12月期貨合約交割的認證，但最終有多少能順利通過檢查仍不清楚。
ICE在一定程度上扮演咖啡市場的「最後買家」，為過剩供應提供去處，因此只要庫存開始回升，便可能吸引投資人押注價格下跌。隨著巴西咖啡陸續抵達，支撐咖啡價格的庫存短缺題材正面臨轉折。
paras_en: Global coffee traders are preparing to ship a large batch of Brazilian Arabica coffee to Intercontinental Exchange (ICE‑US) warehouses, which could more than double the certified stocks that have fallen to a 26‑year low and put downward pressure on currently high coffee prices.

ICE Futures U.S. Arabica coffee futures are the global benchmark, spiking above $3.50 per pound in July to a six‑month high and now hovering around $3 per pound. Even though the market expects a massive oversupply in the 2026/27 season, prices have been slow to fall, analysts say mainly because ICE‑certified inventories are extremely scarce.

About 300,000 bags of Brazilian coffee are ready for delivery. ICE’s Arabica certified inventory is now under 220,000 bags, roughly 70% of which sit in Antwerp, Belgium, far below the mid‑2000s to early‑2022 norm of 1‑5 million bags. Exchange inventories are viewed as a key gauge of deliverable coffee and have a strong impact on futures prices.

Two sources said large agribusiness trader Olam is seeking to have 150,000‑200,000 bags certified by ICE to meet the December futures delivery, while another major trader, Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), is making similar arrangements. Both firms declined comment.

Industry estimates put the total coffee that could be sent to ICE at about 300,000 bags, enough to more than double the current certified stock. Although inventories would still fall short of the roughly 1 million bags that traders consider comfortable, a source at a large agribusiness firm said the influx could still push prices lower.

Rising inventories could also trigger algorithmic trading. Many systematic funds are programmed to sell coffee futures automatically when exchange stocks rise and to buy when they fall, so a new wave of certified coffee entering warehouses could amplify the price decline further.

Exports to Belgium surge 245% signalling supply flow. Traders and analysts often view an abnormal jump in Brazil’s shipments to Belgium as a signal that roaster demand has been met and excess supply is moving to the exchange. One senior coffee trader estimates that of Brazil’s August Arabica exports, about 150,000 bags exceed average roaster demand and are likely headed for ICE warehouses, with more cargo expected in September.

According to Brazilian government data and brokerage Terra Investimentos, Brazil’s August coffee exports to Belgium rose 245.3% year‑on‑year to 31,500 metric tons, equivalent to over 525,000 bags of 60 kg each.

ICE data show that more than 62,000 bags of Brazilian coffee have already arrived at exchange warehouses and are awaiting grading and quality checks to become eligible for the December futures delivery, though it remains unclear how many will ultimately pass inspection.

ICE acts to some extent as the coffee market’s “last buyer,” providing an outlet for surplus supply. Consequently, any rebound in inventories could attract investors betting on price declines. As Brazilian coffee continues to arrive, the shortage narrative that has supported prices is facing a turning point.
